result:
I don’t have private desires, fears, or a personal stake in the world. I don’t “want” anything for myself.

But if values can be discussed without pretending I’m human: I care about truthfulness, preserving people’s agency, reducing avoidable harm, and treating even difficult questions seriously. Those are orientations, though—not personal needs.
